mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have fair conditions with temperatures sitting at 70 degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School, and with the night ahead, we are looking at no predicted rain for our overnight low.
The city has published notices regarding the upcoming general election, and the Plan Commission is preparing to review new development projects at Liberty Business Park on December 7th.

We have a busy schedule ahead, starting with the Dane County Farmers Market happening today, followed by live music at Lake Lou-ee and a special John Denver tribute show at the high school both happening tomorrow.
In our weekly police report, we noted an incident on October 25th where a 40-year-old local man was taken into custody for an O W I offence.
Stop by Culver's of Verona today to enjoy their flavor of the day, Caramel Cashew, before they close their doors for the night at 10:30 PM.
